scenarios.prompt: Compare first-session progression across two builds using the same funnel revision. Define ordered steps, cohort, denominator and observation window so counts are reproducible.

criteria.definition: funnel_id/revision, ordered steps and telemetry schema versions are explicit.
criteria.denominator: Cohort, denominator, window, deduplication and excluded population are named.
criteria.inference: Aggregation is deterministic across ingestion order and correlation is not reported as causal gameplay proof.
